Inboard and sterndrive service and repair: MerCruiser, Volvo Penta, inboard gas

Sterndrives and inboards in salt water need the service outboards get, plus a few more: bellows, gimbal bearings, manifolds and risers, raw-water pumps, and outdrive oil. Mobile mechanics handle it at the slip or on the lift.

What's included

  • Engine oil and filter, fuel filters
  • Raw-water pump impeller
  • Outdrive oil and seals, bellows inspection
  • Manifolds and risers inspection (salt water)
  • Belts, hoses, thermostats
  • Shift cable and trim system
  • Fault code scan (MPI and later engines)
When

Annually; bellows every 2 to 3 years; manifolds and risers typically 5 to 7 years in salt water.

Time on site

3 to 6 hours

What it usually costs here

$500 to $1,200 for annual service; manifold and riser jobs $1,200 to $3,000; bellows and gimbal work $800 to $1,800.

In Tampa Bay specifically

Many St. Petersburg and Tampa cruisers live in slips year-round. Annual service on the slip beats a yard wait list by weeks.

Engines

MerCruiserVolvo Penta

Questions we get

Why are manifolds and risers such a big deal?

Salt water runs through them. When they rust through, water enters the cylinders and the engine is done. Inspection at service time catches it.

Can you haul the boat?

We do dockside and lift work. For bottom work or a drive that needs the boat out, we coordinate with a yard.
